intro.text: A guard at the Thaylen Gemstone Reserve in Thaylen City.

items.text: Fladm was one of the guards on rotation at the door to the queen's personal sphere vault, and Rysn knew him from her accounting work there. During the Battle of Thaylen Field he waited near the entrance while Rysn and Vstim went in to work on an audit with another vault guard, Tlik, and a member of the Queen's Guard.

The Queen's Guardsman was a Fused in disguise; he murdered Tlik and stole the King's Drop ruby. Fladm was first to hear and ran in raising the alarm, shooting the infiltrator twice in the back, but the Fused healed and shot him dead with Tlik's crossbow. Rysn then took Fladm's crossbow and used it to shoot the Fused while Chiri-Chiri kept him from healing.
